stage_conditions.bind_identities: loads no model and measures nothing. Binds the derived joint-space size and its branching functions, the excluded implementation and why, the two calibration mixtures by qualified id and materialization, the frozen state_eval suite, the policy hash and its epsilon, the teacher revision and the pooled cost table's sources. A disagreement here is a STOP, not something to compensate for.
stage_conditions.full_joint_search: ONE beam over the derived full joint space at the standing width, with impl_profiles UNPINNED so calibration competes, and no conditional baseline candidate -- B is measured and frozen and this session compares nothing. It trains nothing and scores no battery.
stage_conditions.commit_top_k: freezes the Top-5 ranking as a PREREGISTERED candidate set and STOPS. The set is committed before any probe result exists, so it cannot grow once one does; a session that continued into screening would select and confirm on the same evidence.

scope_note: exactly ONE Phase-C2 full joint re-search session at a TOTAL hard ceiling of $34.8742: the derived 578-leaf space (576 decomposed), standing beam width 6, warmup level 1, both frozen calibration profiles, the accepted operator library with its frozen exclusion, the CURRENT OPTIMIZED state evaluator, the current DEPTH forward-KL-only implementation, frozen PARETO_V1 ranking, terminating at a committed Top-5. The session MUST end at commit_top_k.
enforcement: the launcher loads this artifact and refuses to create a pod whose priced hard threshold exceeds hard_cap_usd or per_launch_hard_usd, refuses a stage not in authorized_stages, refuses a harness that does not digest to the authorized value, and has no code path to any experiment after Phase A

resource_scope._what_a_provider_resource_is: a resource the provider RETURNED AN ID FOR. A create call that returns no id created nothing and billed nothing, so it does not consume this count; it is still recorded as a draw with pod_id null, because the provider's refusal is the only evidence of why.
resource_scope._what_this_does_not_relax: the dollar ceiling, which every draw in the session shares, and the runner's requirement that the provider confirm a resource is not billing before the next one is created.

scope: ONE beam over the DERIVED full joint space at the standing beam width, and ONE committed Top-5 candidate set. The session ends at commit_top_k. NOT a recovery probe, NOT a behavioural measurement, NOT a re-run of Search-1, NOT a remeasurement of B or any frozen C candidate, and nothing that names an incumbent.
forbids: any behavioural screening or confirmation probe
remeasuring B or any frozen C candidate

one_use.what_that_means: this grant funds ONE launcher session. Inside it the launcher may replace a host that never became usable, up to three provider resources in total, ALL sharing this session's single $34.8742 ceiling. Three rather than two because the live quote reports stock Low for the L40S and a draw that never becomes usable costs minutes; the MONEY is the real bound and it does not move. A replacement is created only after the provider confirms the previous resource is no longer billing.
one_use.machine_readable: the four values above become a resource scope in the authorization and are checked before any provider is contacted.
one_use.consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization, whether or not a provider resource follows and whether or not any money is spent.
one_use.retry_rule: PRE-SCIENCE ONLY. Ordinary provider acquisition or startup failures may be diagnosed and handled inside this grant's existing resource and money scope when NO scientific measurement has begun AND the previous resource is provider-confirmed non-billing. THE INSTANT full_joint_search begins producing formal search measurements, loss of the session is NOT an ordinary engineering retry: preserve evidence, tear down, reconcile spend and RETURN FOR REVIEW before repeating any formal scientific work. If it is uncertain whether formal measurement started, that uncertainty is itself a stop condition.

bound._rule: every value here was DERIVED from this tree at issuance: the closure by import walk from the full-search entry points, the space by walking the real registry through the same two branching functions the search itself calls, the plan from the protocol's own hash, the ceiling from the pricing record's minutes times the grant's re-quoted rate. None was read from a document that merely claims it.
bound._the_ceiling_moved_with_the_rate: priced at $1.09/h, issued at $1.09/h over 1826.58 ceiling minutes. The MINUTES are the plan; a rate change re-derives the dollars and never the beam.

readiness._rule: the sweep ran on the grant commit and this issuance is the next commit after the record; the gate re-checks both.

approved_money._stated_and_rederived: the maintainer STATED these in the grant and the issuer recomputed the expected cost and the ceiling from the pricing record's minutes at the grant's own live rate. A grant naming a different figure, or a rate above the boundary it states, is refused.
